title: Venus as the evening star
caption: the first star you wish on at dusk is often venus. bright enough to cast a shadow
cta: align with the right person ✦ the align app, link in bio

lines: The first star you wish on at dusk
it's the brightest thing in the *sky.*
But you'll never see it at midnight.
It never strays far from the *sun.*

scenes.header: STAY CLOSE TO WHAT WARMS YOU
lines: The brightest love works like that.
It doesn't wander off into the *dark.*
It stays close to what *warms* it.

opts.sub: READ THE SKY BEFORE THE FACE

lines: Someone out there already speaks your *language.*
